analysis.extraction_limits: Source dates: maps produced by MapAction 06/07/2026 in response to 24 Jun 2026 earthquake; legend shelter data references 2027-07-03 (likely placeholder), retained as printed. Capacity figures in 'pp' (people) are reproduced verbatim from labels; the suffix '(1, fixed)', '(1, mobile)' and parenthesised numerals (3) on IOM/CCCM sites indicate shelter type/count rather than people and are reported as null capacity. '(0pp)' labels on two Page-2 CCCM sites are reported as 0 but flagged medium confidence because the value is unusual and may reflect an empty/placeholder field. All abbreviations (Rep., Esc., UEN, UENB, UEE, EBR, VE) are not expanded beyond what is printed. Several health/operational acronyms (NFH, IMPM UPEL, Sam./Sum. Purse) could not be reliably interpreted and are marked low confidence. No coordinates, opening dates, or after-the-fact status are inferred; absent labels are not treated as evidence of absence. Visible label set was limited to what is legible at the supplied image resolution; overlapping or partly clipped labels near parish/road names were excluded. Map symbology reflects what the source mapped on its stated date and is not proof of operational status before or after.

visible_small_shelter_units_estimate.explanation: Count of small tent-like/improvised shelter units (mostly blue tarpaulins, some pink, green and grey) arrayed in rows around the perimeter of the site (north, east, south and west edges) and in clusters between the large structures. This is an image-based count of clearly separable units only; it is not a population or capacity figure. Tents partially occluded behind the large Dormitorio, the Comedor, or adjacent to perimeter walls cannot be reliably distinguished, and clustering makes individual units ambiguous in places. Range is therefore conservative.

Warehouse-type grey-roofed building on the east side of the site

A larger vehicle (bus or small coach) parked on the northern road
Several vehicles parked within the camp near the Entrada and along the western internal road
A white van/light vehicle visible just north of the Dormitorio
Yellow construction/excavation equipment on the east side of the site
Vehicles visible on the southern road
extraction_limits: Map is a single dated snapshot (7 July 2026); it does not establish when the site opened or its later status.
Small shelters behind or adjacent to the Dormitorio, Comedor and perimeter walls are partially occluded and may be undercounted.
Clustered tents in dense rows cannot always be individually separated; count is given as a range and is an image estimate, not occupancy.
No population, capacity, WASH counts, or number of users can be derived from an aerial view.
Outside buildings (residential/industrial) are visible but not annotated; their function is not labelled on the map.
Service-area polygons (yellow/green overlays) are MapAction cartographic annotations layered on the imagery; they are not physical infrastructure.

Separate scattered blue tarpaulins/tents around the periphery are not included in this count.

extraction_limits: Map represents the layout only as of 7 July 2026; status before or after this date is not documented by the map.
The dense field of white dome tents is not labeled with a function in the map — they could be family shelters, communal housing, or storage; the map does not confirm.
Tent count is an image estimate; overlapping units, tarps, and resolution prevent a precise count.
Vehicles and pedestrian activity are point-in-time and do not indicate camp throughput or capacity.
Some labels (e.g., 'Dormitorio', 'Puesto de salud') point to highlighted orange polygons that group multiple tent/canopy elements together; individual bed counts are not derivable from the map.

analysis.vehicle_observations: No vehicles are directly labeled or clearly annotated on the map. Some small light-colored objects are visible in the open ground area, but none are identified as vehicles by the source.
analysis.extraction_limits: The map is a thematic site-layout overlay on satellite imagery, not a structured count product. While small light-colored rectangular features are visible scattered on the open ground (possibly tents), the 30-meter scale, lack of a legend defining shelter symbols, partial tree cover, and image resolution make any count of shelter units non-defensible. Two 'H' symbols in white circles appear in the lower left without a corresponding legend entry in the visible map, so their meaning is not confirmed. No occupancy or capacity figures can be derived. The map documents what was mapped on 04/07/2026, not the operational status of the site before or after that date.

Not a population or capacity figure.

visible_large_structures: Approximately 3–4 large white/light-grey rectangular structures (likely communal tents, warehouses, or distribution halls) located in the upper-central portion of the peninsula, just north of the main road and adjacent to a green sports field / open ground area.
vehicle_observations: Light vehicles and what appear to be small trucks visible parked along the main road and at the edges of tent clusters.

extraction_limits: Map is minimally annotated; no callouts, legend, or service icons are present, so directly_annotated_services and annotated_sleeping_areas are empty by design.
Resolution of the drone image does not allow reliable distinction between family tents, tarps, awnings, or vehicle covers among the blue objects.
Permanent pre-existing town buildings cannot be cleanly separated from transitional camp infrastructure without ground-truth data; the count conflates both.
Image is not a population, capacity, or needs-coverage assessment; shelter count is a visual estimate, not an occupancy figure.
No date field, scale verification, or symbology key is shown beyond a graphic scale bar in metres.

extraction_limits: Only labels, legend entries, symbols, and distances explicitly printed on the two maps are transcribed. No facility operating status, bed count, service availability, or actual exposure to debris is shown.
The wind text block in Map 2 extends toward the right edge of the frame; the arrow is clear but the bounding box of the annotation is partially clipped.

The 'Parque Tecnológico Ambiental Santa Edvugis' label and the 'Punta Tanguarena' label are set in small type and partly overlap road/relief shading; spelling reproduced as legibly as the image allows.

Buffer rings on Map 2 are drawn around the disposal sites themselves; the printed table is the only place a numeric distance is given, so numeric values are taken from the table, not measured from the rings.

The maps show static positions of disposal sites and health facilities as of 16/07/2026 and 17/07/2026 respectively; they do not prove whether a site was open before or remained open after those dates, and absence of a label is not treated as evidence of absence.
Health-facility distance figures are copied verbatim from the printed table; no re-derivation or unit conversion was performed.
